scope: Qualify the delay stream correction, then compare original selection and benchmark-only shadow confirmation on the frozen MLP fixture with only the delay wrapper binding changed.

upstream.head: e6bcdebdefff9ad6dd635cb357ead72b0e7f9da6
upstream.delta: Import tvm_ffi and bind the scalar native delay invocation with tvm_ffi.use_torch_stream(); no native changes.

inherited.use: Use original plan, fixture, worker, candidate enumeration, measurement settings, confirmation order and graph replay recipe. Historical results are excluded from new estimates.

source_contract.variant: The same qualified FP8-only descriptor port plus fixture-owned validation callback in every cell; no configured-timer guard or old scoped-cache prototype.

fixture.selection: Prespecified first-layer MLP down projection from the same checkpoint and exact prior 144 input token IDs, before observing any tuning or execution timing. Verify actual dimensions and capture provenance.
fixture.source: Dense BF16 reference forward with actual captured post-nonlinearity activation; benchmark uses static per-tensor FP8 weights/activations through the SGLang linear facade.

source_contract.no_historical_pooling: Prior cohorts provide source/protocol context only; no historical or admission observations enter current estimates.

native_reuse.restoration: Restore exact source archive plus the already-qualified tools and Python-only callback patch; restore entire native cache from the prior private archive. Never rebuild or change native artifact contents.
native_reuse.timestamp_amendment: Archive extraction loses subsecond cache mtimes. Restore eight object mtimes from their unchanged .ninja_deps records. Reconstruct two library filesystem mtimes from build-log timestamps; these are explicitly not claimed original library stat mtimes. Source archive mtimes remain unchanged; every source-owned dependency must precede its recorded build timestamp.
native_reuse.reason: Restore the already-qualified artifacts from durable archives without rebuilding; reuse the independently audited MLP fixture from the completed comparison.
native_reuse.isolation: Fresh process, home and tuner cache per worker; only compiled native artifacts are reused.
native_reuse.failure: Stop before measurement if archive/source/native hashes differ, a dependency timestamp is inconsistent, or actual pinned-container Ninja requires work. No implicit rebuild or load-only fallback.

protocol.launch_order: Alternating baseline-first and patched-first; same block uses identical inherited schedules.
protocol.cache: Fresh process, container home and isolated empty tuner cache per worker. Reuse only verified identical compiled native artifacts.
protocol.ordering_gate: Before admission or timing: verify current Torch default/nondefault stream ordering and ambient FFI restoration with conflicting FFI stream against same-native explicit-binding reference. Old wrapper must expose the ordering defect; patched wrapper must pass eager and graph replay/numerical checks. Preserve all observations if the gate fails; do not run ranking cohort.
protocol.diagnostic_isolation: Ordering diagnostics run in dedicated processes and never inside a timing worker. Identify actual imported wrapper/FFI and native providers before measurement.
protocol.admission: One independent disposable inherited MLP admission worker per arm. Both must satisfy source/native/cache/numerical integrity, with their own wrapper identity. Exclude admissions from timing estimates.
protocol.timing: Eight complete pairs using unchanged inherited worker. Original winner and v1 cache remain immutable; confirmation is a hypothetical comparison only.
protocol.measurement_policy: Unspecified, inherited auto/non-graph hot-L2 event timing. Requested delay remains 5000 us; native reference duration is measured rather than assumed.

analysis.unit: Eight complete paired blocks; within-process profiler pairs and graph windows are dependent repetitions.
analysis.primary: For each process let L be median(log(explicit_graph/default_graph)) over all 24 graph windows, and O=1 for original explicit choice, 0 for default. Compare exp(O_fixed*L_fixed - O_baseline*L_baseline); geometric mean over eight paired blocks. Default choices score exactly 1 relative to their own default.
secondary: Shadow-confirmed/default normalized score and shadow/original score from the same retained post-confirmation graphs.
Every original and shadow tactic, first-pass profile margin, confirmation ratio, graph ratio, original-to-shadow reversal, corrected/introduced/remaining slower choice.
Absolute default graph timings and capture-order/launch-position strata as contextual diagnostics, without treating absolute timing differences as isolated selection effects.
Cold startup host elapsed time and available confirmation-profiler host intervals separately from graph replay timing. Original startup profiles have GPU event times but no per-call host intervals.

uncertainty.unit: Complete paired blocks resampled with shared indices across metrics.

analysis.no_pooling: No historical or admission observation enters new timing estimates. No adaptive margins, retries, exclusions or sample expansion.
analysis.decision: This fixed cohort tests the causal effect of the wrapper correction on this measurement/selection protocol only. Correct ordering is independently useful even if no selection improvement is demonstrated. No automatic production change or PR.

stopping.integrity: Stop and preserve every attempted artifact on ordering, source, provider, cache or numerical failure. Any amended attempt requires explicit new source/protocol identity; no silent retries.
stopping.performance: Complete all eight paired blocks irrespective of timing sign. Retain neutral/adverse outcomes.
stopping.resource: One original exclusive H100 node, 30-minute allocation bound after source staging; release after durable preservation. No full model download.

limits: Both original and shadow decisions are scored on graphs captured after confirmation work. This is not untouched startup or full-model serving performance.
Dynamic explicit finalists may differ by process. Pairing identifies the effect of the wrapper intervention on the whole declared protocol, not a single fixed-kernel comparison.
One fixture, physical GPU and contiguous time window do not establish universal safety, rare-error rate, equivalence or a broad serving speedup.
An enforced conflicting-FFI-stream negative control proves susceptibility. Record natural loaded binding behavior separately; do not retroactively claim the historical trace proved a stream mismatch.
Preserve original evidence and inconclusive stopping decisions. No SGLang production change, policy change, managed-store migration, scoped-cache adoption, PR or CI trigger.

binding.application: Separate source-file overlays mounted at the same canonical source path before imports. Every other qualified source and native artifact must remain byte-identical.
binding.control: Baseline file matches qualified source27c62; patched file is byte-identical to upstream head e6bcdebdefff9ad6dd635cb357ead72b0e7f9da6.
